case_number: 2025 INSC 204; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 14618 of 2024)
summary: Custody and access to child; father's interaction allowed, child not to be taken abroad; CCTV installation ordered at residence with 96-hour recording; expenses allocated; Court Commissioner appointed; interim order continues pending Guardianship Court decision; proceedings under Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 ongoing; prima facie observations, no final findings; respondents barred from technical objections to attorney nomination; appeal allowed and disposed of.
legal_provisions_cited: Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995
National Trust for Welfare of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities Act, 1999
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; directions issued regarding child access, CCTV installation, and Commissioner appointment; interim order to remain in force until modified by competent court; pending applications disposed of.
